description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per call — the payment buys one signed payload-budget report for one submitted payload and your stated token budget: (1) a fit verdict stating the payload's token count under the pinned cl100k_base tokenizer, your effective budget, and whether it fits or the exact excess; (2) where it does not fit, a shaped payload produced only by the four published mechanical operations (S-1 duplicate removal, S-2 empty-field removal, S-3 per-field truncation, S-4 tail truncation, in that order); and (3) a drop receipt listing every operation applied, by field, with token counts before and after that reconcile exactly. No operation selects content by meaning; nothing is summarised or rewritten by a model. Submitted payloads are processed in memory only and never stored; the paid retry re-sends the payload.

budget_tokens.description: The token budget the payload must fit, counted under the published pinned tokenizer (cl100k_base). No default: a call without a valid budget_tokens is a free validation refusal.

keep_fields.description: Optional field paths protected from shaping operations.

payload.description: The one payload to check, as text or as JSON text. Processed in memory only and never stored.

reserve_tokens.description: Optional reserve subtracted from budget_tokens to form the effective budget.

name: token_efficiency_budget
